summary: Warnings for Ramelteon include severe allergic reactions, such as rapid swelling under the skin (angioedema) or life-threatening responses (anaphylaxis), which mean the drug should not be taken again. [3] The official warnings also note that sleep problems lasting more than 7 to 10 days need a doctor's review, along with potential issues involving unusual thinking and behavior. [3] Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Ramelteon low risk scores for both liver and heart issues. [M]
